# Vendored [Dreagonmon/littlefs-js](https://github.com/Dreagonmon/littlefs-js) v2.5.1.0

Real littlefs (C → Emscripten) for mounting Zephyr-formatted SPI NOR images in
the dock Filesystem dialog. Release assets:

- https://github.com/Dreagonmon/littlefs-js/releases/tag/v2.5.1.0
